block_summaries.summary: Block 1 completed 30 deterministic synthetic tasks for S005 across all ten task types. Objective, dependency, state, two refs, and the three fixed constraints were preserved per task. UNKNOWN was never coerced to FAIL, no external facts were introduced, and no product or Current authority was claimed.
